title: February Financial Review
content: This month has been particularly tough with the rent increase and the student loan payments piling up. I've had to tighten my budget significantly and forgo some of my usual activities to make ends meet.

title: Volunteering at Paws & Claws Haven
content: Had an amazing time volunteering at the local animal shelter, Paws & Claws Haven. It's so rewarding to help these animals find their forever homes. I'm looking forward to my next session there!
